Fixes #33959

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增全仓调度车道 `repo:objectstack` 的章程 `lanes/objectstack.md`,在 SKILL.md 车道表登记一行,席位词收进 `objectstack`,并给新文件补行数上限。启动方式是项目指令 `pm-dispatch objectstack`。
- 为什么改:您 11-15 说要「开一个全仓调度车道」「在多个 agent 开多个座位。通过信箱协调分工」,车道名「就是仓库名」。
- 风险与回滚:只改智能体规则文本和行数上限脚本,不改产品代码、不发包;现有各车道不受影响;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/objectstack.md` 的「多席分工」节(多席如何分区、怎么防撞);② `SKILL.md` 域车道表新增的一行;③ `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` 中 SKILL.md 320 → 321 及其裁决引注。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`,应见 `lanes/objectstack.md is 35 lines (ceiling 35; headroom 0)`、`SKILL.md is 321 lines` 且退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无。受管面 Tier S(`check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 33961` 读数):契约复审已 PASS(记录 6896645503),检查全绿后由 server 5 席在 #33938 落地后入队;您也可直接合并。

## What changes

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/objectstack.md` (new, 35 lines).** The charter writes only what is specific to a whole-repo lane with several seats, and points at the owning references for everything else:

- Shape: seats `repo:objectstack#N` on any number of accounts; every seat runs area-lease mode (`area-lease.md`). It is NOT a single-lane-repo seat, so `cross-repo-coordination.md`'s single-lane-repo line and `seat-lifecycle.md`'s matching line do not apply: first touch, grading and `domain:*` stay with triage. The board's `repo:objectstack` label is retired from circulation and H14 still reads it as a seam label, so the lane never puts it on a card.
- Scope: every claimable card in this repo across all `domain:*` labels, which still decide file ownership and serialisation. Cloud cards go whole to the `repo:cloud` seats and security advisories to `security`. Domain-lane seats keep running; `area-lease.md`'s pre-claim re-read applies with 「他区」 read as another seat or another area.
- Multi-seat split, the new part: an area is held by one seat at a time. Each seat's lease table lives on its own seat post, and together they make the lane's lease record. Area names carry the seat prefix so `lease:` labels stay unique. Before opening, splitting or taking over an area, a seat reads every seated sibling's and domain-lane seat's lease table; a path overlap means it writes to that seat first. Area names and path roots live only in the lease tables; `Notify: split` keeps its template (card numbers only). Leases replace `execution-duties.md`'s odd/even alternation for this lane. A contested area goes to the earlier area-declaration comment on the seat post, per `seat-lifecycle.md`'s race rule. Same-file work between areas uses the `git merge-tree` overlap check from the maintainer's 14:41Z ruling, with `SINGLE_CLAIM_PATHS` still single-writer per `execution-duties.md`. A seat clocking out hands in-flight work to a sibling; the leaving seat deletes its lease rows and the taking seat writes its own.
- Landing and hand-off to the seat: a pointer to `area-lease.md` and SKILL.md 〈路径分叉〉.

**`SKILL.md`** gets one 域车道 row naming the lane and its file. No existing row can carry it: the security · review · eval row is 1 byte under its 341-byte pin.

**Review.** First head 68bb5050: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` FAIL (record 6896586223: `Notify: split` carried areas its reader refuses; edit-stamp arbitration; blanket ban on file exclusivity; restated lines). Head c22bc5e8 fixes all four; delta record 6896645503 PASS.

**`references/project-forms.md`**: the seat-word line said seat words equal the file names under `lanes/` and enumerated ten of them. It already lacked `cloud` and `security`. It now states the rule once (file name without `.md`, the directory is the full set) with examples including `objectstack`. Line count unchanged.

**`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`**: a `CEILINGS` row (35) and a `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` row (0) for the new charter, set at the landed count like every lane charter. `SKILL.md` goes 320 → 321 as an ordinary ruled raise. The ruling of record is the maintainer's words quoted in card #33959 (filing gate ③). Measured delta +1.

**Name check.** `repo:objectstack` needs no script change. `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` (`check-half-states.mjs`) accepts `repo:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`. `mailbox-open.mjs`'s seat shape accepts the `repo` kind. `fleet-roster.mjs` resolves a `repo:X` seat to `objectstack-ai/X` and matches every card on that repo, which is this lane's scope. So `SEAT_BARE_LANES` / `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` stay as they are. The mailbox-open and fleet-roster self-tests pass unchanged.

**Relation to #33938.** That PR writes today's seven area rules into `area-lease.md`. This charter only points at that file, and its line on cross-lane cards points at a rule that exists only at that PR's head, so #33938 lands first. `git merge-tree` against its head finds no textual conflict, although both PRs touch the ratchet script in different rows.

## Tests

No runtime code changed. `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: 164 cases pass. `mailbox-open.mjs --self-test`: 90 cases pass. `fleet-roster.mjs --self-test`: 115 cases pass.

## Acceptance notes

- `skip-changeset`: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing.
- Lines in the charter are each ≤120 bytes; no `#NNN` ids in the pm-dispatch corpus (`check:pm-skill-id-lint` clean).
